title: Bound on the number of influential coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to $\{-1,1\}$. If the variance of the associated real-valued function is positive, then the number of variance-Friedgut coordinates of $f$ is at most $64 I(f)^3\,9^d/\operatorname{Var}(f)^2$, where $I(f)$ is its total influence and $d$ is its variance-Friedgut degree.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
the variance of the associated real-valued function is positive
